defs.def: a person who believes in or supports socialism; a member of a political party that believes in socialism 社会主义者；社会党党员adj.

ex.s: But now, interviews can be done online … More than 40 years ago, China began to implement the reform and opening-up policy, starting out on a journey that would pave the way for China to become a fully-modernised socialist country.
ex.t: 但现在，面试可以在线进行了……四十多年前，中国开始实施改革开放政策，踏上了为中国成为社会主义现代化国家铺平道路的征程。

ex.s: The geophysicist Huang Danian, who practised core socialist values, is a good example.
ex.t: 地球物理学家黄大年，践行社会主义核心价值观，就是一个很好的榜样。
